title: Return to New Orleans, the Hummingbird and the Streckfus riverboat offer
summary: Called home by his wife's operation, he works at the entertainers' club and Hummingbird and turns down the Streckfus boat job.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Working the Streckfus riverboats with Fate Marable

blocks.x: Then I stayed with Toody Harris about a year. Eight months a year. I got a telegram that my wife fixed to be operated on on a Saturday. And I got the telegram that Friday evening. And that's when I left that Friday evening. Come here. And uh... That Monday I went to work at the humming board. No, I played at the entertainers. I played at the entertainers for about six, eight months. And then we left there and... I went to the humming board. And that's where I sent for Guy Kelly, trumpet player. Sent for him. And he come down there. We stayed at the humming board until it closed. And that's when Stretchford used to come off the boot. Used to come up and hear me play clarinet. And he would never come inside. He'd sit outside all the time. In his car. I would never know he'd be out there. But somebody come in and tell me he's out there. Him and his wife and his brother. Used to come out there and sit down and just let him play. Fate Marble was playing with him at that time on the boot. And uh... He asked Fate to bring me out there. One night. I went out there. Stayed out there. I stayed out there. Played out there with him until he got ready to make the trip and leave. Well, I couldn't go on that trip. He didn't come back until twelve o'clock. I had to come back to work. I was just a boy. Well, I played that matinee with him. And uh... I had to leave him come back to work until six to pull out. But he wanted me to join the band. Go back up to St. Louis. But that boot job was a little bit too hard. You get up in the morning at 6.30. Eat breakfast in your oasis for two hours. Eat lunch. And you go back. Rehearsal about two more hours. And you rest and go back to work that night. Uh... Too much. I didn't like all that playing. Of course I liked to play, but I didn't like that much playing. Just to be playing to the empty walls like that. So I told him no.
I didn't think I wanted to go. I was doing alright there by the hummingbird. But anyway...
